sights.w: Gate-free 20-acre I-Drive entertainment hub anchored by The Wheel, a 400-ft observation wheel (opened 2015 as the Orlando Eye) with 50-mile views on clear days, plus the 450-ft StarFlyer and SlingShot.

sights.address: Pointe Orlando, International Drive, Orlando, FL
sights.w: Upside-down "sinking" building with upended palm trees outside and ~100 interactive science and VR experiences inside; a Fodor's best sight on International Drive.
Family amusement park and I-Drive cornerstone for 20+ years, with Central Florida's only wooden roller coaster, the Freedom Flyer suspended coaster and a SkyCoaster.
sights.k: roller coaster amusement park family ride

sights.address: SeaWorld Orlando resort complex, Orlando, FL
sights.w: SeaWorld's South Pacific-themed water park (opened 2008) mixing slides with animal habitats; Visit Orlando spotlights its Ray Rush raft slide.

sights.address: SeaWorld Orlando resort complex, Orlando, FL
sights.w: Marine theme park whose signature experience is swimming with bottlenose dolphins; admission now also includes SeaWorld and Aquatica (Orlando Informer).

sights.address: Disney Springs, Lake Buena Vista, FL 32830
sights.w: Cirque du Soleil's Disney-animation tribute (opened Nov 2021) about an animator's daughter, praised by Theme Park Insider, Laughing Place and Attractions Magazine; Orlando Weekly marked its 4th anniversary.

sights.address: Disney Springs West Side, Lake Buena Vista, FL 32830
sights.w: Giant tethered helium balloon (Aero 30) lifting riders ~300 ft for 8–10-minute flights with ~10-mile panoramas over Disney Springs (AllEars).

sights.address: Walt Disney World Resort, Bay Lake, FL
sights.w: Gondola system opened Sept 29, 2019: five stations, 250+ cabins linking four resorts with EPCOT and Hollywood Studios on Doppelmayr D-Line technology.
